name: L&T Technology Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, L&T Technology Services is an engineering and technology services company, a subsidiary of Larsen & Toubro, providing design, development, testing, and maintenance services across products and processes. [1]
keyPoints: Business Segments[1][2] 1) Tech (~33% in FY26 vs ~30% in FY25):[3] The company focuses on engineering-led product and platform innovation across sectors, including MedTech, Media & Technology, and Software & Platforms. Its focus areas include AI and GenAI integration, platform engineering, connected ecosystems, digital health solutions, cybersecurity, and lifecycle management to support product development and digital platforms.
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 44.9%
